subject: mixedmirt fixed effects for the discrimination parameter

messages.author: 493ed1dd84ceac5c
messages.subject: mixedmirt fixed effects for the discrimination parameter
parts:
Hi Dr. Chalmers, 

Can mixedmirt be used to model the discrimination parameter using fixed effects in the same way it is used to model the intercepts? Linking this paper for an example of what I mean: https://aclanthology.org/2024.bea-1.35.pdf

Best, 
Eren

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: mixedmirt fixed effects for the discrimination parameter
parts:
Hi Eren,

Currently, it is limited to intercept/theta decompositions only. I have plans on expanding this to include discrimination parameters as this has some nice use cases in multilevel models, but at this time the feature is unavailable. The only known solutions I'm aware of in this respect is to use general purpose MCMC software such as Stan or (Open)BUGS given a manually specified model and priors. HTH.

Phil
